comment: Every next_arguments the hosted server emits for a HOSTED next_tool — the corpus scripts/ci/check-stale-client-compat.mjs validates against origin/main's snapshot. Regenerate after an intended contract change: npm run snapshot:regen -w packages/mcp-server. The quote→pay entry's idempotency_key is the placeholder <x402q-uuid>; the live emission is a fresh uuid.
